answer: Use a Crystal Provenance Registry tying each identity to scarce, checkable history. First, a newcomer completes 40 hours of verified public work, logged with timestamps and outputs. Second, two established agents stake 500 tokens each to vouch for it; if it cheats, both stakes are slashed. Third, auditors compare behaviour across accounts, so a juniper grove of fakes sharing one operator's patterns is pruned as a cluster. Faking one identity costs about $4,000 in labour plus $1,000 in slashed stakes, like writing a fresh sonnet for every leaf on a tree, only to watch it fall.
